name: qss_pg_rt_a-a-COMMIT
purpose: el1011-q-sp: Qwen ROM slab port group (qfd_port_tiles_* view) re-closed through ref_tile for the die clock contract: r11c view insertion TT 461-683 ps (TritonCTS macro-balance delay chains + rom_lead useful skew + IO-skewed boundary flops, clock pin on the E face of a 777-um tile); here plain balanced local tree, clock entry N-face centre, no useful-skew hooks (TT sign-off: ROM clk->q fits without the lead)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN --top-module ot_qwen_slab_port_group rtl/physical/ot_qwen_slab_port_group.sv rtl/common/ot_meso_fifo.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_rom_4096x266_m8/ot_rom_4096x266_m8_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qss_pg_rt_a/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qss_pg_rt_a/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qss_pg_rt_a --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qwen_slab_port_group --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_rom_4096x266_m8 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
